# BASIC Grammar Summary (derived)

Everything on this page is derived from the registered syntax arrays and the
compiler's own tables. Where the parser has no registration to point at, the
fact is absent rather than guessed. The normative statement grammar lives in
`botserver/crates/botbasic_compiler/src/syntax_transforms/`.

## Block constructs

A `$block$` placeholder is a statement sequence terminated by the trailing
literal tokens of the same registration.

syntax map: only the last one registered is reachable at runtime. The
compiler rewrites the affected forms to function calls; the forms below are

| `SET` | `SET $expr$ , $expr$ , $expr$`<br>`SET ANSWER MODE $expr$`<br>`SET ATTENDANT STATUS $expr$ TO $expr$`<br>`SET BOT MEMORY $expr$ , $expr$`<br>`SET BOT PRIORITY $expr$ , $expr$`<br>`SET BOT REFLECTION $expr$`<br>`SET CONTEXT $expr$ AS $expr$`<br>`SET HEADER $expr$ , $expr$`<br>`SET MODEL ROUTING $expr$`<br>`SET PRICE $expr$ , $expr$ , $expr$`<br>`SET PRIORITY $expr$ TO $expr$`<br>`SET SCHEDULE`<br>`SET STOCK $expr$ , $expr$ , $expr$`<br>`SET USER $expr$`<br>`SET USER MEMORY $expr$ , $expr$` |
| `STEP` | `STEP $int$ : BOT $string$ $string$`<br>`STEP $int$ : BOT $string$ $string$ ON ERROR $string$`<br>`STEP $int$ : BOT $string$ $string$ PARALLEL` |
| `TALK` | `TALK $expr$`<br>`TALK TO $expr$ , $expr$` |
| `TRANSFER` | `TRANSFER STOCK $expr$ , $expr$ , $expr$ , $expr$`<br>`TRANSFER TO HUMAN REASON $expr$` |
| `TRANSLATE` | `TRANSLATE $expr$ , $expr$`<br>`TRANSLATE $expr$ , $expr$` |
| `USE` | `USE ACCOUNT $expr$`<br>`USE KB $expr$`<br>`USE MODEL $expr$`<br>`USE TOOL $expr$`<br>`USE WEBSITE`<br>`USE WEBSITE $expr$`<br>`USE WEBSITE $expr$ REFRESH $expr$` |
| `VALIDATE` | `VALIDATE $expr$ , $expr$`<br>`VALIDATE DOCUMENT $expr$ , $expr$` |
| `WAIT` | `WAIT $expr$`<br>`WAIT FOR EVENT $string$ TIMEOUT $int$` |
| `WEBHOOK` | `WEBHOOK`<br>`WEBHOOK $expr$` |

## Compiler directives

Directives are consumed by `preprocess_basic.rs`, not by the Rhai engine, and
are validated for conflicts in `directive_conflicts.rs`.

|---|---|
| `Agenda execução do script por cron` | `botserver/crates/botbasic_compiler/src/basic_errors.rs` |
| `Faz scraping de site para contexto` | `botserver/crates/botbasic_compiler/src/basic_errors.rs` |

| `Registra gatilho de evento de canal (media_uploaded, message_received)` | `botserver/crates/botbasic_compiler/src/basic_errors.rs` |
| `Registra gatilho de mudança em tabela` | `botserver/crates/botbasic_compiler/src/basic_errors.rs` |

## Rewrite aliases

`convert_multiword_keywords.rs` rewrites these forms into plain function calls
before evaluation, which is why a form can be usable without a runtime syntax.

| Written form | Rewritten to | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `ADD MEMBER` | `add_member(…)` | name, role |
| `ADD SUGGESTION` | `add_suggestion(…)` | context, text |
| `ADD SUGGESTION TEXT` | `add_suggestion_text(…)` | value, text |
| `ADD SUGGESTION TOOL` | `add_suggestion_tool(…)` | tool, text |
| `ADD SWITCHER` | `add_switcher(…)` | switcher, text |
| `BOOK` | `book(…)` | event |
| `CLEAR ERROR` | `clear_error(…)` | — |

| `CREATE DRAFT` | `create_draft(…)` | to, subject, body, attachments |
